R3.allowed_thresholds_reason: REMOVED 2026-09-20, SAME DAY IT WAS ADDED, BY MEASUREMENT. This list is EMPTY and must stay empty on this property. THE JUSTIFICATION THAT WAS WRITTEN HERE AND IN RULES_SPEC WAS FALSE, and is corrected rather than deleted so it cannot survive as a true-looking statement. (1) IT CLAIMED the entry was needed because an overlap rule could not separate the legitimate blower-door FAQ row from the laundering evasions, all four pairs sitting at overlap exactly 3. MEASURED FALSE: with this list empty, R5's f_question goes from 'matched 4, removed 0' to 'matched 4, removed 3' and removes all three blower-door FAQ rows (LD, LOWVIS, VIS) BY ITSELF. It matched them with the list populated too, and removed nothing only because f_struct sits earlier in the filter chain. The exclusion was never load-bearing for the case it was justified by. (2) WHAT IT WAS ACTUALLY LOAD-BEARING FOR was three rows, one string, one page: the page title 'Denver Blower Door Test - CFM50, Xcel's 20% Rebate Rule' on locators (title), (og:title) and (twitter:title). Those are now cleared by f_title_np, a rule mechanism with NO per-property configuration, which requires the figure to sit inside a possessive publisher's own named artifact on a page-title locator. (3) IT OPENED TEN EVASIONS, not the five first reported. MEASURED with a synthetic fixture, one uncited first-party performance claim per threshold_context_marker: with this list populated, 'Our crews deliver a 20% CFM 50 reduction on every air sealing job' and its nine siblings all CLEARED; with it empty, all ten FIRE. The entry needed only '20%' plus one of the nine markers - which are this site's own subject matter - so it licensed precisely the claims this property is most likely to make falsely about its own work. An eleventh, '10-20% CFM 50 reduction', cleared through the substring hole the old note itself predicted. THE SAME HOLE IS STILL OPEN ON GCI AND LGM and is reported, not fixed here, because this row's brief requires both to stay at exit 0: same probe, GCI clears 14 of 16 (its threshold_context_markers include the bare words 'reduction' and 'leakage'), LGM clears 12 of 16 at its own 25% tier figure.

subject_phrases: lower at Denver elevation than at sea level
derivable_constants.derivation_note: ICAO standard atmosphere, P/P0 = (1 - 2.25577e-5*h)^5.25588. At h = 1,609.3 m (Denver, 5,280 ft) this gives 0.8234, i.e. 17.7% lower than sea level; the pages round it to "roughly 17%". Computed 2026-09-18, re-derived and wired into the engine 2026-09-19. THIS IS A PHYSICAL CONSTANT, NOT A STATISTIC: there is no publisher to cite any more than there is for water's boiling point at altitude, so R5's demand for an attribution cannot be satisfied and should not be made. The five rows are public/r-value-altitude-denver.html VIS x3 and LOWVIS x2. The second subject phrase exists because one LOWVIS segmentation variant reads only "roughly 17% lower at Denver elevation than at sea level." -- the subject is in the preceding block and the sentence splitter does not carry it across.

quotation_allowlist.text: The guidance here says "not yet" as often as it says "yes,"
quotation_allowlist.why: NOT A QUOTATION AT ALL, so there is nothing to verify and nothing to attribute. R1 half B is a STRING LIST, not a claim test: it finds a quote glyph, looks back 40 characters for an attribution verb, and fires. It has no way to ask WHO is speaking. In each entry below the speaker is a common noun -- not a publisher, not a named source, not any person -- and the quoted span is a scare quote or reported hypothetical speech, the same category of legitimate use Ruling 10 already protects for 'stack effect'. about.html. The speaker is 'the guidance here' -- this site's own editorial stance, describing how often it tells a reader NOT to buy. '"not yet"' and '"yes"' are the two answers it gives, set in quotes because they are being named as answers. No third party is quoted, paraphrased, or named. THE STRUCTURAL FIX IS OWED AND THIS IS NOT IT: R1 half B should require a RECOGNISED PUBLISHER inside the same 40-character lookback before it fires, which would clear all four of these portfolio-wide and cost no true positive, because a genuine fabricated quotation names its publisher by definition. That is a change to claim_gate.py, not to any config, and claim_gate.py had uncommitted changes from another session throughout this pass -- editing it would have risked that session's work. Allowlisted narrowly, per sentence, until the engine change lands; then delete these four entries.
